title: Design principles
tables: Digitize recognized methods instead of replacing them with unsupported AI shortcuts.
Persist raw images, calibration state and boundaries before S/I/R rules are applied.
Independent embedded control preserves thermal and interlock behavior if the AI host fails.
The software proposes, explains and records; qualified personnel confirm reportable results.
Core operation survives loss of internet; cloud adds collaboration and fleet services.
Optional research and robotics modules attach through stable mechanical, electrical and software interfaces.
Every externally stated capability maps to a verification or validation artifact.
